_comment: Single pricing + access config for the R&R Brain Gateway. Pedro changes prices, keys, and caps HERE — nowhere else. No code change is needed to change a price. Keys below are TEST/DEMO keys for Lou's black-box testing only; rotate them before any real buyer gets access.

customer_quote_ranges._comment: Defaults / placeholders only — Pedro sets the real ranges. The gateway shows them as typical ranges, never as a final price.

keys.label: Low-quota test key — quota 1, for testing the 402 out_of_credits response
Rate-limit test key — high quota, 5 requests/minute, for testing the 429 response
Staff key — order_glass + 10,000 lookups/month. Keep private; never hand to customers or API buyers.

mygrant._comment: MyGrant paid VIN lookup costs $1 per lookup (see apps/api/src/mygrant.ts MYGRANT_VIN_LOOKUP_COST_USD). The gateway never spends it without a staff key and never charges on a failed lookup.
